title: First time, tenth time
description: Each row joins an earlier and a later reading on one shared scale, with both values written above.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-ordered { id, label, start, end } rows with unique nonempty IDs. Readings may be signed; null and non-finite values are unavailable and read as a dash. A row with both readings draws its connected pair; a row with one draws only that reading's dot.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Name of the earlier, hollow reading. Defaults to Before.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Name of the later, filled reading. Defaults to After.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement heading and tooltip unit. Defaults to Value.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned context beside the heading.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats direct readings, axis ticks and tooltips. Defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimal places.

props.name: animate
props.description: Defaults to true; each connector draws from the earlier reading to the later one and honors live reduced-motion changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional container classes. The chart fills its parent; narrow containers scroll locally.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible chart title. Arrow keys inspect rows through Recharts.
